content.title: Independent git branch for issue storage
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md

Store .agentrack/ issue data on a dedicated orphan branch (_agentrack) mounted as a git worktree. Makes issue pool independent of code branch. Three new/modified CLI commands: agt init (worktree setup), agt push (commit + sync), agt pull (sync from remote).

content.content:
Planning complete. Issue chain created:

2. **Quality review** (mpcwf20ucn) — library-quality reviews spec testability  
3. **Implementation** (mpcwg66ygs) — library-developer implements worktree module + CLI commands (blocked by both reviews)
4. **Quality validation** (mpcwg61w9c) — library-quality validates against spec (blocked by implementation)

Spec: .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md (REVIEWED — extensively evolved in session 52)

Key design decisions:
- Orphan branch via git plumbing (no branch switching, no working tree modification)
- Three init scenarios: fresh (create branch), join (fetch existing), already-initialized
- Existing Tracker/file-io layer unchanged (AC7)
- Explicit agt push/pull sync model (no auto-commits on every write)
